extracted.intended_audience: editors of medical journals and general readers seeking information about WAME
extracted.subtask_description: A short encyclopedic summary of the World Association of Medical Editors (WAME), its purpose, history, membership eligibility, and leadership. The page is a Wikipedia article describing the organization rather than publishing WAME policy text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Any editor of a peer-reviewed biomedical journal is eligible to join WAME.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WAME is an international, virtual organization of editors of medical journals; membership is open to editors of peer-reviewed biomedical journals (no further membership criteria are provided on this page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational purpose and goals
rubrics_metrics.description: WAME's purpose is medical education and to enable greater international cooperation between editors of medical journals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The organization was founded in 1995 after a conference intended to enable greater international cooperation; it was formed by editors concerned that ICMJE had become 'too small, self-serving, and exclusive.' The page lists leadership, founding history, and that WAME addresses issues such as conflict of interest (referenced but policy details are not included on this page).
